title: selenicereus wittii
intro: Selenicereus wittii, commonly known as the 'Queen of the Night', is a species of flowering cactus native to Mexico. It is a type of epiphytic cactus that blooms at night, producing large, showy flowers with a strong, sweet fragrance. The health benefits of Selenicereus wittii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The plant's therapeutic actions include its potential to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
